svg.title: No individual-transport smallness is required for this averaged statement. For a radius-r box of N sites, replacing selected coordinates of x by those of y gives dp(x, y). Swapping those coordinates is an endpoint-pair involution, hence P x,y f(dp(x, y)) = N P x f(x). Swapping a site coordinate with an independent height likewise gives X x,height f(updatej(x, height)) = (2r + 1) X x f(x).
